steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...You've finally come.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Naturally, I would not dare refuse an invitation from the Vine-Bead Court... Great Elder Adso.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: If I remember correctly, it shouldn't take very long to get from the Silverash domain to the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: To be summoned to the Vine-Bead Court is a matter of great importance. As I stand accused of improper dealings with Victoria, I had to make ample preparations to prove my innocence.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Without further ado, Sir Enciodes, please come inside so that we may discuss this further.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: One moment, please.
A large convoy of vehicles pulls up to the center of the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Silverash... What is the meaning of this?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Are you not investigating the ties between Karlan Trade and Victoria?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I had someone compile all the documents related to the last decade of business dealings between Karlan Trade and Victoria. It is quite the voluminous collection, so much so that we had to fill several trucks.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Great Elder Adso, if it interests you, please take your time to read through it.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Good... Very good.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Unload everything, then tell your people to leave.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm afraid I can't do that.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: What is the meaning this, Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It is true that as of late, Kjerag has had to weather great turmoil. Undoubtedly, Victoria has been at the heart of many of these incidents.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Indeed, our troops have discovered evidence of contact between the Vine-Bead Court and Victorian spies.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Empty accusations. Without proof, what right do you have to investigate the Vine-Bead Court?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Investigate? I would never dream of such a thing. However, the Vine-Bead Court has accused me of 'colluding with Victoria', and so I am here.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: By my command, nobody is to leave the Vine-Bead Court today until Great Elder Adso and I reach a conclusion.

steps.name: Tschäggättä
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Now then, Great Elder Adso.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...We've never talked like this before.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I have hardly even seen you on my past visits to the Vine-Bead Court, let alone spoken with you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I've heard from many clerics that you spent years in seclusion, studying the scriptures in the Hall of Writings and never concerning yourself with temporal affairs.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It seems you've also come to handle the affairs of the Vine-Bead Court with ease.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: The only thing I've done over the years is ensure that Kjerag follows the path She ordained.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Moreover, we stand at a critical juncture concerning our survival. Should the Vine-Bead Court stand by and watch you drag Kjerag into the abyss, allowing Kazimierz, Victoria, or any other foreign power to devour us?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: You are not the king of Kjerag, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Thank you for the admonition, Great Elder. If Kjerag were to have a king, it could only be Her.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If there are diplomatic errors the Vine-Bead Court wishes to correct, then Karlan Trade will do our best to cooperate.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, there is one question that puzzles me, for which I seek your guidance.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How exactly is the Vine-Bead Court negotiating with Victoria?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Is it using all of Kjerag as a bargaining chip?

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Cleric
steps.text: Elder!

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Cleric
steps.text: (Whispering) We just took a look around. Silverash's troops have already blocked the way down the mountain.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Cleric
steps.text: (Whispering) We, we'll go check the back door and—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The secret passage?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I wouldn't bother with that unless you're keen on searching for Tschäggättä.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Cleric
steps.text: Ahh!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Don't be alarmed. By Kjeragandr, I have no intention of attacking the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Tell everyone outside to rest where they are. No one is to move without my order.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...Enciodes, you accuse the Vine-Bead Court of betraying Kjerag to Victoria. Where is the evidence for your claim?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Please be patient, Great Elder. It will take some time for the evidence to be delivered here.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: In other words, you came empty-handed yet still chose to resort to violence against us.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: You should know what the price is for doing this, head of the Silverash clan.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Look down at the people beneath the mountain. Your elite troops might be able to block off the Vine-Bead Court, but you cannot fight all of Kjerag.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I am willing to give you time... But if you cannot produce conclusive evidence before sundown, I'm afraid that the reputation of Karlan Trade, and even that of the entire Silverash name, will be in tatters.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: You will become untouchables throughout the land of Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Indeed. I am, of course, well-aware of the consequences of my actions.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What I do not know, however, is what it would mean for Kjerag if the Vine-Bead Court is found to be colluding with an enemy that assassinated leaders from the three clans, and was caught in the act of espionage.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I will be with you to witness that moment, Elder.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...I know exactly what you're waiting for.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: But, time is not on your side, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Agitated Local
steps.text: Let us in! We were invited by the Vine-Bead Court to participate in the blessing ceremony, and Silverash's goons have no right to stop us!
Throughout her illustrious career, The Black Knight was unshakeable, even by the most fearsome opponents.
But now, looking down at the teeming crowds crammed onto the narrow mountain road, she feels utterly helpless for the first time.

steps.name: Agitated Local
steps.text: Why haven't we seen a single cleric here? What is Silverash trying to pull?!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Please calm down, everyone. The Vine-Bead Court... has encountered some extenuating circumstances, and Sir Enciodes is assisting with the investigation.

steps.name: Agitated Local
steps.text: We came here on an invitation, and you're telling us that there are 'extenuating circumstances' now that we're here? Cut the crap!
A man squeezes through the crowd, but as soon as he takes a step forward, he is met with Degenbrecher's cold glare and has no choice but to retreat, muttering under his breath.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Sir Enciodes will issue an explanation to the public after things have settled down. Please, I ask that you all return home for now.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...Ma'am, be careful—

steps.name: Elderly Local
steps.text: I'm fine, Degenbrecher. I can stand on my own...

steps.name: Elderly Local
steps.text: We all trust you. We know that you're a daughter of Kjerag and would never bring us harm.

steps.name: Elderly Local
steps.text: So, can you tell this old woman exactly what is happening with the Vine-Bead Court? What do you know about this whole thing?
A vehicle winds its way along the mountain road; outside the window, dense dark clouds are gathering, mingling.
The window rolls down, and a few snowflakes laced with unidentified impurities slide into the car before disappearing without a trace.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: The signal's a little better now.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: According to our informant, Victoria and the people from the Vine-Bead Court have left the mining site, and have not made any further moves.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But given this weather, we can expect more heavy snow... It'll take a lot longer to get back to headquarters than expected.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Compared to THAT, this little hiccup can hardly be considered beyond our expectations.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Are you referring to those Victorians from earlier?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: They got the intel they wanted, but so did we.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I mean the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: The Vine-Bead Court, huh...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: The fact that they'd show up here instead of calming the populace is rather strange indeed...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's evident that they were completely unprepared for the situation, and their deliberate attempts to hide their schemes are easily seen through.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If some of them are willing to play cover-up for the Victorians—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Then, it's only a matter of time until the mask comes off.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's nearly time.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Turn back to the mining site.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Are you trying to...?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The exit ways there are now open, making it a good place to leave the country.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: As you just heard, Enciodes has already surrounded the Vine-Bead Court with his men. He has deliberately made a big show of things to alert the enemy.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Those hiding in Kjerag will definitely be itching to seize the moment.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Our undercover agent friend we've been tracking seems to have a particular fondness for this kind of stuff, and should be arriving in the vicinity soon.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Moreover, I suspect she's not the only one either.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Instead of looking for her, we should just let her come to us.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Gather everyone together and keep a close eye on the entrance to the mining site. Pay extra attention to—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The people who helped her escape.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...While you were on your way, the clergy throughout the city were already inviting people to come up the mountain for the ceremony.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I wonder, how long Degenbrecher can hold them back?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Did the Vine-Bead Court stoop to these desperate measures knowing I would not point my weapons at the people?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: It's true that I'm using them, just as you did to Arctosz and Ratatos during the Holy Hunt a few years ago.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Perhaps I overestimated you, Sir Enciodes. Even if you're hungry for power, you should be less obvious about it.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Before you commit a grave error, I am willing to announce to the public that you've come to the Vine-Bead Court to capture the Victorian assassin.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If you truly thought highly of me in any capacity, you would not think that I am only 'seeking power'.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: All I care about is the future of the land of Kjerag.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: So, a violent coup is the best path forward?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Because our Victorian friend sits in a position that cannot be reached except through violence.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Hahahaha! What you say is true, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: The unarmed Vine-Bead Court, driven to despair by the descendants of Victorians and their acolytes, helpless to defend themselves even when thieves cry thief in front of them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Behavior determines identity better than blood.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It is a fact that since the attack on Ensia, people from the Vine-Bead Court have been falling over themselves to back Victoria.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If you are so confident you know what I'm waiting for—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The cleric and the Victorian spy caught red-handed together. Be it for the general public or the three clans, the rest speaks for itself.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I know no more about the conduct of these clerics than you do.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Even if the Duke of Caster were to come here herself, she would only tell you that I firmly rejected her offer.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That is nothing more than an excuse. A failure to control your subordinates means you are equally responsible for them, and the same applies to Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...What you suggest is that the clergy of the Vine-Bead Court indulge in pleasure and collude with foreigners, while I remain oblivious and allow them to sell out Kjerag?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: You and Victoria share many of the same delusions; in reality, the Vine-Bead Court has only ever wanted to use this as a pretext to expel Victoria and their true ally—

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Enciodes Silverash.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, the reality is that they ended up aligning with Victoria in practice—

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: All the clergy who've associated with Victoria have sworn an oath of death after you are expelled.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Their bones will nourish Kjerag's future, and they will leave no regrets behind.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So, what you propose is that Kjerag should purge itself, down to those who hunt Victorian spies to this day, those who the Duke of Caster considers enemies...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And THAT is the only way to defeat Victoria?
There is nobody around. A sudden gust of wind suddenly howls through the unfamiliar courtyard.
Carolin continues to stir around her piping-hot cup of savory milk tea, the spoon continuing to clink against the cup.
She shudders in anticipation, either due to the drink or her impending evacuation.
She stares at the swirling tea and strokes the cup, completely ignorant to the fact that the cup is engraved with Kjerag's mountain ridges.
Her thoughts are interrupted by a knock on the door.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: ...Stay back!

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, young lady of Victoria.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: It's you...

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: Please pardon my intrusion, but due to the situation changing, you will be transferred to a new destination ahead of schedule.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: ...What happened?

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: I only know the gist of the Vine-Bead Court's decision.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: A 'gist' isn't good enough. We need to have a concrete plan of action, or else...

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: I will take full responsibility for the operation until you have safely left Kjerag's borders.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: All you need to do is follow the instructions. As for how to leave and who will help you—

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: Don't overly concern yourself about such things.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: Kjeragandr witnesses all, and She shall walk with us.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Stop trying to fool me with your vague and nondescript dogma...

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: In other words, I've become your responsibility now, right?

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: I am but a follower of Her will.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Fine. You have your beliefs, and I have mine.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: But since we'll be working together, let me remind you that if this operation fails, your side will also be exposed.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Does that not worry you at all?
The cleric simply smiles gently and takes a garment out from his bag.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: No, young lady.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: All I need is faith.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: You can also place your faith in us. As long as we are of one heart, we can overcome our fear.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Cleric of the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: I don't think we need to discuss this any further.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Instead, let's focus on something useful, like when we leave.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: My apologies, young lady. This is a cleric's robe that I sewed myself. Please put it on for now.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: This journey will take you past many people and countless eyes. If you encounter someone who comes up to you seeking prayer or answers, do not try to please them. Stay silent, and avoid them.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: I will walk with you, no matter what dangers we may face.

steps.name: Carolin
steps.text: Color me curious. Why do people pray to your god for protection even after a Catastrophe?

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: Just in case.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: Believe me, young lady. You know too little about Kjerag.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: Now, please pack your belongings. I will wait for you outside.
The door opens, and a dry, cold wind rushes in, lashing at the cleric's neck and face.
An old dagger slips from his bag, and he nonchalantly bends down to pick it up.
He knows exactly what this amulet, forged for him by his father who has returned to Kjeragandr, will ultimately be used for.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Elderly Cleric
steps.text: May this devout body be blessed, and may it spread Your holy will.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: They brought excellent seeds to Kjerag as well as machinery... The Vine-Bead Court has never denied these contributions.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: To be frank, I have never seen anyone so complicated in my already-withering life...

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Hero.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This does nothing to dispel my doubts.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Compared to these acts, the Vine-Bead Court seems only to recognize friend and foe based on where they come from.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Then, allow me to ask you a question first, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: In your heart of hearts, what exactly is Kjerag?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...I have already answered this through my actions.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Victorian-style buildings. Victorian-style weapons. Victorian-mandated laws.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Is this your answer?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Unless we choose to seclude ourselves deeper within the mountains, shunning both external disturbances and any further advancement.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Otherwise, you might even be able to see things from Laterano or Leithanien one day.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Until one day, the people of Kjerag believe in nothing but Originium and money, unless faith itself can be sold.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Once the shell of Kjeragandr is ripped open, the people shall no longer hold any reverence for eternity. They will only chase after their own values and desires.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: They will hate the strong because in this new 'theater', the more one abandons his morality, the stronger he becomes.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: They will hate the weak because the weak will come to occupy the crevices of pity and charity.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Nihilism will become the most popular ideology; the people's hearts will become empty and detached, and they will take pride in this emptiness.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Your ideals are slaughtering the people of Kjerag, turning Victoria's present into our future.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...The Kjeragandr that the Vine-Bead Court worships is far more fragile than the one I worship.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If all it takes to overthrow our sacred beliefs are a few foreign tools, then how has Mount Karlan stood to this day?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: How could it be that foreign tools can cover our mountains and rivers, yet foreign ideas can never be touched?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If this is what you believe, then you must also admit that what can conquer the body can also conquer the soul.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Born into a dark and hopeless era, you must race faster than the clouds to avoid being swallowed by darkness.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Faith should not drive people to become accustomed to the darkness, but rather unwaveringly affirm the yearning for light.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Yet, the more pious one is, the more destitute he becomes. In due time, he will see piety as a noose, and begin to hate the history of faith itself.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Which is why those who adhered to the teachings of Kjeragandr were ridiculed as pedantic and ignorant.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Without turning on the tap, there is no clean drinking water. Without applying chemical fertilizers, there is no fertile farmland.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: You leveled the mountains and forests to build your factories, then sent the displaced back to the ruins of their homes to either sell their labor or die.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: The lives you've improved for some, are fed by the happiness you've stolen from others.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: O eloquent grandmaster, I ask you—how should we deal with the 'stragglers' left in your wake?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...You are right. It is a heavy responsibility that I must accept.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, the Vine-Bead Court only fantasizes about incremental change while continuing to regard doing nothing as a virtue.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Such people have no right to judge me.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I have never sought to block Kjerag's progress. My only responsibility is to pull the reins on self-important tourists before things spiral out of control.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: You're moving too quickly, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The way to format the Kjeragandr, the way to punctuate prayer passages, which hand to raise during rituals... are debates that can last for centuries.

spans.text: , the way to punctuate prayer passages, which hand to raise during rituals... are debates that can last for centuries.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Elder of Clan Browntail, you have both the talent and the platform, and yet you only yearn for the solace of the other shore.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Yet when you hide away in the Hall of Writings and philosophize from your armchair, do you know anything about where Kjerag is actually headed?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: What I know... is that Kjerag would never let an apostate take the helm. And, I have never been one to 'philosophize from my armchair'.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: You are not the first apostate I've dealt with.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: What memories come to mind when you hear the names, Olafur and Elizabeth Silverash?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: This bloody weather again... Damn it, why's there a traffic jam in a place like this?

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: Hey, you in the back. The road's about to get real bumpy.

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: If you want to be able to stand after getting out of the truck, I'd recommend taking a nap now and conserving your energy.
Inside the rear compartment, the lights flicker as the truck sways. The passengers trying to escape sit upright on their haystacks, eyes tightly shut.

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: Shit, what's that thing in front of me?!

steps.name: Victorian Agent
steps.text: Urgh...
An oil slick spills across the middle of the road, and in front of the stopped truck is a line of fully-armed men.
The engine emits a strange, strained noise, and the windows are splattered with paint.
Inside the driver's seat, the Victorian tightly grips the steering wheel.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I've never tried to hide where I come from, even though it's something that others have long forgotten.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...Luca Browntail. Ratatos and Sciurus's grandfather. My cousin.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: In order to achieve the same goal, we accepted different fates—to safeguard Kjerag's order through the Tri-Clan Council and the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Though known for his ruthlessness, he still harbored fantasies about the Silverashes until the very end.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: He said: 'A peaceful resolution is never impossible, as long as the couple are willing to make concessions.'

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...But, I have never lived in fantasy.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That train accident...

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Hahaha... Is that what you believe? Or, did Ratatos make you believe it?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: How many clergymen and devotees do you think are out there among the commoners?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: If the masses wish for Kjeragandr to punish the apostates, then I, serving the Vine-Bead Court, shall deliver on those wishes.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...Sir Enciodes!

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: The man who killed your parents is right in front of you.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Those who commit murder will be punished twice over by Kjeragandr. This crippled body has lost any meaning for me long ago!

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I grant you permission to dispose of me as you wish for reasons private and public, not for treason, but for murder. Arrest me here and put me on trial!

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Let the people of Kjerag see just how sinful it is to kill an apostate!
The old man wobbles to his feet, his withered fingers clenching into fists as if using all his strength. Suddenly, he stretches his arms out before Enciodes.
Like a sinner waiting to have his confession heard, his cloudy eyes shine with a glimmer of light, as if seeking to quench decades of old grudges with another's anger.
Enciodes slowly closes his eyes, his fingertips wrapping tightly around his cane.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If you're trying to provoke me into acting out of line, I'm afraid your efforts are in vain.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I won't lay a finger on you here...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: All I can do is ensure that you receive a fair trial...
